claim: Heliopause by Coco Research gives local AI tools a Lead and roles on your machine and serves a live status page locally over loopback.
Loopback-only local server with no account, no telemetry and no remote sync.
Runs on the Python standard library and git with zero external Python package dependencies.
Shows each agent as working, idle, blocked or needs-you with its latest line and pulse links.
Includes a built-in sample company preview before you point it at your own folders.
Release archives ship with SHA-256 digests and an ED25519-signed manifest verified via ssh-keygen.
Details soon for upcoming milestones; the public repository does not list a future roadmap yet.
Source available: early preview (v0.7.3) under Apache-2.0 on GitHub.
